verdict.rationale: Remote is a SaaS HR/payroll platform, so letting customers choose a data storage region or residency is a fair axis. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any data region or residency option. The '90+/150+ countries' claims are about where you can hire and pay people, not where data is stored, so they do not count.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
